#1

NocoDB

Database & Spreadsheets
★ 65,500 Stars

Open source Airtable alternative that turns any SQL database into a smart spreadsheet

NocoDB connects directly to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, or SQL Server and generates an intuitive spreadsheet interface with grid, gallery, kanban, and form views.

Key Open Source Features:

  • ✓ Works on top of your existing production databases
  • ✓ REST APIs & Webhooks for workflow automation
  • ✓ Fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC)
  • ✓ Collaborative multi-user spreadsheet views
License: AGPL-3.0 Stack: TypeScript, Vue, Node.js
